question: Which exact 3.101.043 firmware globals provide MiSans Regular 24 and MiSans Demibold 32 style objects?
callsite_evidence: The device-probed 3.101.036 MiSans-Demibold 32 style global is 0x2010A02C.
The statically recovered 3.101.036 MiSans-Regular 24 style global is 0x20109E1C.

In 3.101.036, sub_C49F944 is the stock lvx_theme_default_init state machine. It references the unique MiSans font resource strings and constructs every family/size style object into a 12-byte-stride writable table.
Within the Regular-family case, 0x20109E1C is initialized by the exact (family=2, size=24, flags=0) constructor sequence.
Within the Demibold-family case, 0x2010A02C occupies the same exact constructor position used by the already device-probed 32px style.
control_flow_evidence: The unique /resource/font/MiSans-Regular.ttf and /resource/font/MiSans-Demibold.ttf strings identify exact 3.101.043 sub_C4C065C as lvx_theme_default_init.
sub_C4C065C and 3.101.036 sub_C49F944 are both exactly 0xFC4 bytes and retain the same switch cases, constructor order, family selectors, size selectors, and 12-byte style-object stride.
At the instruction position corresponding to 3.101.036 0x20109E1C, sub_C4C065C initializes 0x2010CE44 with family selector 2 and size 0x18, proving MiSans-Regular 24.
At the instruction position corresponding to device-probed 3.101.036 0x2010A02C, sub_C4C065C initializes 0x2010D054, proving MiSans-Demibold 32.

0x2010CE44 has 41 exact-target data xrefs and 0x2010D054 has 86 exact-target data xrefs, including their initializer and stock UI consumers; both addresses are writable firmware-owned style objects rather than copied neighboring-firmware addresses.
ownership_analysis: Both addresses are exact 3.101.043 firmware-owned writable style objects initialized by lvx_theme_default_init and subsequently borrowed read-only by UI code. LyraPlayer passes their addresses to the stock lvx_style_apply helper and does not mutate their storage.
unsafe_assumptions: Static recovery proves exact family/size identity and stock use but does not replace an exact 3.101.043 device-rendering gate.
The UI call remains restricted to the firmware UI owner thread.
recommended_probe: Build LyraPlayer for exact 3.101.043, open each native page, compare page-title, primary-label, and author typography against the known-working 3.101.036 UI, and retain the exact artifact hash and crash log if rendering diverges.

artifacts.role: trusted reference theme initializer and style globals
exact 3.101.043 theme initializer and recovered style globals
